title: [DEV] AAPS/AAPSClient NSV3-tab getting alot of spam and stops sync (V3+WS API)
body:
AAPS/AAPSClient 3.2.0-dev-l
Build: f717d7a0b2-2023.09.16

Not sure what triggered it, but last operation I made was enacting TT from AAPSClient around 15:55. Then checked logs and there is alot of spam in both AAPS/AAPSClient NSV3-tab. As a consequence sync isnt working. at 16:05 spam is still there in both tabs.

Workaround:
Disable v3 API, enable v1 API. Then after sync is fixed, v3 API can be used again.
